analyst.summary: Coforge delivered a strong FY26 (revenue +29.2% USD, EBIT margin +370bps to 14.4%, record $1.75bn order book, Sabre deal executing on-plan) but FY26 PAT growth of 91.6% was flattered by a Rs 244cr one-off deferred-tax credit (Cigniti-merger related) -- clean PAT growth is closer to 61-62%. The $2.35bn Encora acquisition (closed 23-Apr-2026, consolidating from May-2026) adds AI-engineering scale but brings a ~25% share-count dilution, a debt step-up to ~Rs 4,000cr FY27E, and a slower-growing, lower-margin acquired business, even as CRISIL's response was an upgrade to AA+/Stable rather than a negative-rating-watch. At a clean trailing PE near 51x (using ex-one-off PAT), the stock is not obviously cheap for FY27 organic guidance of just 13% constant-currency growth, and client/vertical concentration (top-10 clients 31.4% of revenue, BFSI+Travel+Insurance ~70%) is drifting up. With no quant score yet computed for this name, the only defensible call under V1 rules is Hold -- watch the 27/28-Jul-2026 Q1 FY27 print for the first real read on both the growth guide and Encora's blended-in numbers.
